scope: Fresh, zero-authorship source re-verification against EXT-F-1008-T09. No runner, browser, test, build, child agent, or implementation edit was used.

prior_findings.finding: Sparse detail target could pass when description or canonical were present.
prior_findings.evidence: tests/browser/seo-guest-acceptance.mjs now asserts sparseExpected.description === null and sparseExpected.canonical === null before recording the target (around lines 588-590). The earlier source defect is fixed in 65436c9e.

prior_findings.finding: Empty social metadata content could count as present in the public DOM oracle.
prior_findings.evidence: publicDetailEvidence now requires Boolean(node.getAttribute('content')) before counting og:/twitter: metadata (around lines 209-213), matching the nonempty signal rule.

runtime_verdict.reason: No owned native-panel execution or independent UI observation was performed here. Source shows the runner's planned actions and assertions only; it cannot prove the sparse/rich pages loaded, groups rendered, or the new tab actually opened. Existing aggregate status remains partial and does not establish these new T09 targets.

evidence: Sparse page expectations are asserted absent before a pass record; rich detail page must expose nonempty description and canonical and have a title distinct from the sparse page. The displayed detail state is compared with values independently sampled from the public tab DOM.

Canonical activation scopes a unique anchor to the linked selected SEO pane, verifies DOM-derived href, _blank, noopener and noreferrer, checks stable visible hit-tested geometry twice, dispatches mouse press/release, then waits for and verifies an actual new page at the public-DOM URL.

The added detail path uses ordinary public navigation and DOM reads. It does not inject authentication, mock network responses, read or write clipboard data, read secrets, invoke Chat/Pilot, or write account/external data. The aggregate script writes only its local test-results JSON artifact.

Inventory T09 expects available measured groups plus URL/schema doors. This addition verifies selected groups and one canonical URL door only; the preparation report correctly leaves hreflang/schema destinations, broken image fallback, readability/performance values, other URL doors, and member/admin modes outstanding.
limits: The runner labels each target pass after its source assertions, but this report does not independently validate that report-generation logic at runtime.
The aggregate also repeats prior T01/T02/T03/T07 and title/headings observations. Those remain previously earned or partial and are not new evidence from these commits.
This does not constitute full T09, C09, or feature acceptance.
